candidates.name: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)
support_spans: Bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Groups of apoptotic bodies, abundant pink cytoplasmic fragments and small blue dots of fragmented nuclei in confluent necroptosis area
candidates.why: The presence of hemophagocytosis in the bone marrow and necroptosis in the lymph node biopsy are characteristic of HLH.

candidates.name: Inflammatory Leptomeningitis
support_spans: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed:       - Nucleated cells count: 454 (0-5) ×106/L, with 75% mononuclear cells
Leptomeninges thickening and enhancement observed in contrast-enhanced T1 weighted image
candidates.why: The elevated nucleated cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid and leptomeningeal enhancement on MRI suggest inflammation of the leptomeninges.

candidates.name: Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (sJIA)
support_spans: unremitting fever with peak temperature over 40°C
Antinuclear antibodies were positive at 1:100 with speckled pattern
candidates.why: The combination of fever, lymphadenopathy, and positive antinuclear antibodies is consistent with sJIA.
